title: Announcer
description: Announcer is a simple plugin for Paper Minecraft servers that displays customizable messages directly on players’ screens. It broadcasts important information without cluttering chat.
body:
## Announcer Plugin

**Announcer** is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that displays **popup messages directly on players’ screens**, allowing fast and clear server-wide communication.

---

## Features

### On-Screen Announcements
- Shows messages as **center-screen popups**
- Broadcasts to all online players
- Useful for events, alerts, updates, and warnings

### Permissions
- Restrict announcement commands to staff roles
- Separate access for admins and moderators
- Prevents unauthorized broadcasts
- Allows changes in the Fade in, Stay, and Fade out time in the plugin configuration.

---

## Commands

`/announce <title> (<subtitle>)`  
Sends a popup announcement to all players.

---

## Overview

**Announcer** provides a simple and efficient way to display important messages without cluttering chat, keeping communication clear and visible for all players.
